description.value: The Nanaimo Bar is a bar in downtown Nanaimo, BC, cheekily named after the city's iconic chocolate-coconut-custard dessert. Situated on Front Street near the waterfront, it sits along a well-travelled cycling corridor connecting the ferry terminal and downtown. Touring cyclists passing through Nanaimo will find it a natural stop given its central location.
